opening_annotation.strategic_intent: Early tech into Cybernetics Core with a fast expansion, prioritizing technology over production and economy.
supporting_facts: The medoid key sequence is 'Prod_Gateway > Gas > Tech_CyberneticsCore > Gas2 > Combat_gateway > Base', showing early Cybernetics Core before expansion.
The distinctive flag 'first_combat_unit_observed' has a rate of 1.0, indicating that a combat unit is always observed before other typical milestones, suggesting early unit production.
The profile shows high technology investment (0.756) and moderate economy (0.534), while production is low (0.184), supporting a tech-focused opening.
The opening has a winrate of 54.17% across 1488 games, indicating a viable strategy.
